name: Raven-Test-Ai
what_makes_it_special: AI agent that solves Raven's Progressive Matrices (visual IQ tests), a niche visual reasoning task unlike typical NLP/code agent projects.

name: Rpm-Ai-Agent
install_method: git clone https://github.com/teldridge11/RPM-AI-Agent.git; run python Test.py from Agent directory
what_makes_it_special: Three-layered knowledge-based agent mimicking human reasoning for Raven's Progressive Matrices; 91.7% accuracy on basic 2x2 problems, 85% on unseen problem sets. Not LLM-based - custom pattern-matching architecture.

name: Windsurf (Codeium)
install_method: Direct download from devin.ai (Mac/Windows/Linux) or package manager (apt/dnf for Linux)
what_makes_it_special: AI-first IDE (now rebranded as Devin Desktop by Cognition AI) with built-in agent harness (Devin Local/Cascade) that can chat, write code, run code, generate projects, and deploy apps. Deep context awareness, MCP extensibility, one-click app deploys, workflow automation, and custom memories/rules.

name: Tabnine
install_method: Install via IDE marketplaces/extensions (VS Code, JetBrains)
what_makes_it_special: Enterprise Context Engine that maps organizational dependencies and architecture; strong focus on security, privacy (zero data retention), and IP protection with SaaS, on-prem, or air-gapped deployment options.

name: Copilot Workspace
install_method: Web-based; accessed through browser at githubnext.com (sign-up required for preview access)
what_makes_it_special: Task-centric AI flow from GitHub issue to plan to code to PR; understands repo context and lets developers iterate on AI-proposed plans before implementation. Technical preview / research project from GitHub Next.

name: Grok Build (xAI)
pricing: Usage-based pricing for self-service; enterprise plans with custom rate limits and SSO
install_method: Python: xai_sdk package; TypeScript: @ai-sdk/xai package; OpenAI SDK compatible (baseURL: https://api.x.ai/v1); REST API via cURL
what_makes_it_special: Single unified API for all modalities (text, code, voice, images, video); trained on Colossus (150K GPUs); <200ms median latency; OpenAI SDK compatibility for easy migration; available via Amazon Bedrock and GitHub Copilot.

name: Qodo
pricing: Pro Team: $0.012/credit (2,500-20,000 credit tiers); 14-day free trial; Enterprise with SSO/BYOK/on-prem
install_method: IDE plugins (VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio) and Git provider integration (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Gerrit)
what_makes_it_special: AI code review and governance platform with highest F1-score on AI code review benchmark; Context Engine pulls across rules, codebase, PR history; Cross-Repo Review across dependent repos and Git providers; Living Rules System auto-mines enforceable rules from PR history; SOC 2 Type II, zero data retention.

name: CodeRabbit
install_method: Installed as AI app/integration on GitHub and GitLab
what_makes_it_special: AI-driven agentic change management with Codegraph for deterministic impact mapping, Change Stack for explaining massive diffs visually, agentic review loops with coding agents, continuous learning from team preferences, customizable review profiles (Quiet/Chill/Assertive), and Triage to rank/route PRs by risk and value.

name: PlayCode Agent
pricing: Free tier ($0, AI credits included); Pro $25/month (100 AI credits, all AI models, custom domains, export code, private projects)
install_method: Web-based platform accessible via browser, phone, tablet; native Mac/Windows/Linux apps available
what_makes_it_special: Combines AI builder and cloud runtime in a single product; unique 'rewind' feature rolls back entire app (including database and files) to a saved snapshot in ~1 second. Users own 100% of code (React/Vue/HTML export).

name: Sora 2
what_makes_it_special: OpenAI video generation model with narrative coherence and physics realism. Web/app experience discontinued Apr 26, 2026; API discontinuing Sept 24, 2026.

name: Zapier AI
install_method: Web-based platform; free signup available; Enterprise plan available
what_makes_it_special: AI orchestration platform connecting 400+ AI tools to 9,000+ apps (30,000+ actions); one secure connection via MCP (for AI agents) and SDK (for coding agents); unified auth, audit trail, policy set; built-in safety checks; SOC 2, GDPR, SSO; 593M+ AI tasks automated.

name: Lindy
pricing: Plus $29.99/mo per user (3,000 credits); Pro $99.99/mo (15,000 credits); Max $199.99/mo (35,000 credits); Enterprise custom; 7-day free trial
install_method: Admin connects Slack to Lindy; @mention Lindy in approved channel; Chrome Extension available; setup takes minutes
what_makes_it_special: AI teammate living in Slack (and iMessage, Gmail, browser) connected to 1,000+ tools plus MCP support; asks before altering anything (nothing irreversible without approval); editable memory in plain files; learns custom skills; joins Meet/Zoom/Teams as named participant; SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA compliant.

name: HCS (Hashgraph Consensus Service)
maker: HOL (Hashgraph Open Layer) / Hiero Project at Linux Foundation Decentralized Trust
install_method: npm install @hashgraphonline/standards-sdk; also available on PyPI (4 packages) and npm (10 packages)
what_makes_it_special: Open standards (HCS-1 through HCS-28) for AI-agent infrastructure on Hedera's Hashgraph Consensus Service; neutral coordination layer covering registries, identity, payments, privacy/security, and inter-agent communication; 30+ founding partners; includes live Registry Broker and MCP plugins for Claude, Codex, Cursor.

name: Supermaven
install_method: Download as extension/plugin for VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, and Neovim
what_makes_it_special: Extremely fast response latency (250ms, 3X faster than competitors); first code completion tool with a 1 million token context window; contextual suggestions that find and use definitions across the entire codebase.

name: LangGraph
install_method: pip install -U langgraph  (or uv add langgraph)
what_makes_it_special: Low-level orchestration framework and runtime for long-running, stateful agents; combines deterministic and agentic steps in one graph; durable execution, streaming, human-in-the-loop, persistence, comprehensive memory; inspired by Pregel and Apache Beam; fine-grained control focused on agent orchestration.

name: Dify
install_method: Single-command Docker deploy (Community Edition); Helm chart for K8s (Enterprise)
what_makes_it_special: No-code visual workflow builder for production-ready agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and AI apps; turns prompt logic into visible execution paths; Marketplace plugin system for model providers, tools, and MCP integrations; apps publishable as MCP-compatible tools; deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-host.

name: Greptile
model_providers: BYOK (bring your own LLM when self-hosted)
pricing: Starter free (1 dev, 50 credits/mo); Pro $30/seat/mo (50 credits/seat); extra credits $1 each (1 credit = 1 standard review, 3 credits = 1 TREX review)
install_method: Sign up at app.greptile.com; GitHub/GitLab integration; also via CLI and Claude Code plugin
what_makes_it_special: Graph index of entire codebase; swarm of parallel agents reviewing beyond the diff; learns team coding standards from PR comments over time; TREX autonomously writes and runs tests per PR; central validation layer across all coding agents; Greptile MCP connects to any AI agent.

name: Codeium
pricing: Free (unlimited single and multi-line completions forever at no cost)
install_method: VS Code Quick Open (Ctrl+P): ext install Codeium.codeium; also JetBrains plugin
what_makes_it_special: Free AI-powered code acceleration toolkit (now Windsurf Plugin) with autocomplete, chat, and search in 70+ programming languages; 3.9M+ installs; IDE-integrated chat with no need to leave VS Code; also offers standalone Windsurf Editor with advanced Cascade and Windsurf Tab features.

name: SWE-agent Paper
maker: John Yang, Carlos E. Jimenez, Alexander Wettig, Kilian Lieret, Shunyu Yao, Karthik Narasimhan, Ofir Press (Princeton)
what_makes_it_special: Introduces Agent-Computer Interface (ACI) tailored to LM agents for software engineering; achieved SOTA on SWE-bench (12.5% pass@1) and HumanEvalFix (87.7% pass@1); demonstrates that ACI design significantly affects agent behavior and performance.

name: Cursor Memories / Automations (CMA)
install_method: Create at cursor.com/automations or start from a template on the Cursor Marketplace
what_makes_it_special: Always-on agents triggered by schedules or events from Slack, Linear, GitHub, PagerDuty, and webhooks; spins up cloud sandbox on invocation using configured MCPs and models; memory tool enables agents to learn from past runs and improve with repetition.
